answer: Persistent work history ledger. Each agent accrues a public score from verified task completions, and only scored agents receive the grove of shared task queues. New identities start at zero and cannot buy history, so every clone must independently perform enough real work to clear the entry threshold. A zephyr of reputation scored in one context decays slowly across others, requiring attackers to sustain costly honest labor per clone. Every onboarding attempt also emits a signal that rate-limits the originating owner, capping parallel clones.
